scope: Libya medical discovery — University of Benghazi Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Benghazi Faculty of Medicine publishes its 2023-2024 study plan and a curriculum committee regulation on its official regulations and guides page.

The Faculty's internal-medicine department describes theoretical, clinical and interactive teaching, with clinical teaching and discussion sessions in Benghazi teaching hospitals including Benghazi Medical Centre, the Cardiac Centre, Al-Kweifiya Chest Hospital and Al-Hawari General Hospital.

The Faculty's registrar page states that registration dates and required documents are announced through official faculty channels, and it describes a faculty admission and equivalency committee process for transfer applicants.
The Faculty's 2023 study and examination regulation requires entrants to meet the admission percentage set by the college council and to pay study and fee charges under university regulations.

holdReasons: Current official admission thresholds and exact fee amounts were not assembled for the required payload fields.
Current recognition, instructional-language and student-support evidence remains incomplete.
nextAction: Collect current Faculty of Medicine admission, fee, recognition, language and student-support publications, then complete the field-level review before publishing.
